body:
*Written by the Stylfixx team · Reviewed by Omar Sharieff, Director, Stylfixx Innovations Pvt. Ltd. · Last updated 10 November 2026*

**Quick answer:** For most bedrooms and living rooms, a gypsum board false ceiling is the best choice: it is quick to install, clean, smooth and costs about ₹70 to ₹110 per sq ft in Bengaluru in 2026. Choose POP when you want curves, domes or detailed mouldings that boards can't make easily. Use PVC panels in bathrooms, balconies and utility areas, where moisture would damage gypsum and POP. Grid ceilings suit offices and shops.

## POP vs gypsum vs PVC compared

| Factor | Gypsum board | POP (plaster of Paris) | PVC panels |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| How it's made | Factory-made boards screwed to a metal frame | Wet plaster applied on site over a mesh and frame | Interlocking plastic panels on a frame |
| Finish | Smooth and uniform; joints taped and filled | Seamless; can be shaped freely | Ready finish; visible panel lines |
| Best for | Bedrooms, living rooms, offices | Curves, domes, mouldings and detailed designs | Bathrooms, balconies, kitchens, utility areas |
| Installation | Fast and relatively clean | Slower; messy; needs drying time | Fastest |
| Moisture | Standard boards are not for wet areas; moisture-resistant boards exist | Damaged by moisture | Waterproof |
| Cracks | Few, if joints are taped properly | More prone to hairline cracks | Doesn't crack; panels can warp in heat |
| Cost (2026, Bengaluru) | ₹70 – ₹110 per sq ft plain; ₹110 – ₹170 with layers and cove lighting | ₹65 – ₹110 per sq ft | ₹60 – ₹130 per sq ft |

Rates are typical installed prices including frame and labour, before lights and wiring. Your exact price is fixed in a written quote.

## Gypsum vs POP: which is better?

Gypsum is better for most homes today. Boards arrive ready, so a room is done in a day or two with little dust, and the finish is consistently flat. POP is mixed and shaped on site, which makes it slower and messier, and the quality depends heavily on the craftsman. POP's advantage is shape: curved edges, domes and detailed cornices are easier in POP. Many homes combine both, with a gypsum ceiling and POP details along the edges.

## When PVC makes sense

PVC panels are waterproof, light and quick to fit, which makes them the practical choice for bathroom ceilings, balconies and utility areas. They look less refined than gypsum in living spaces, and cheaper panels can sag or discolour in heat, so choose thicker panels from a known brand.

## Which false ceiling for which room

| Room | Best choice | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Living and dining | Gypsum with layers and cove lighting | Clean finish, hides wiring, frames lighting |
| Bedroom | Plain or single-layer gypsum | Simple, quiet, cost-effective |
| Kitchen | Moisture-resistant gypsum or PVC | Steam and grease |
| Bathroom | PVC or grid with moisture-resistant tiles | Waterproof |
| Balcony | PVC | Outdoor moisture |
| Office or shop | Grid (mineral fibre) or gypsum | Easy access to services above |

## What a false ceiling costs for one room

For a 10 × 10 ft room (100 sq ft), a plain gypsum ceiling costs about ₹7,000 to ₹11,000, and a layered design with cove lighting about ₹11,000 to ₹17,000, before lights. Lights, profile lights and wiring are priced separately.

## Things to check before you install

- **Ceiling height:** a false ceiling usually drops the ceiling by 4–8 inches; keep at least 9 ft clear in living spaces if you can.
- **Leaks above:** fix terrace or bathroom leaks first; water damages gypsum and POP.
- **Wiring and AC:** plan light points, AC ducting and fan rods before the boards go up.
- **Frame quality:** galvanised steel framing at the right spacing prevents sagging and cracks.

title: Which False Ceiling Is Best? POP vs Gypsum vs PVC Compared
description: Which false ceiling is best for your home? Gypsum, POP and PVC compared on finish, moisture, cracks and 2026 Bangalore cost per sq ft, room by room.

faqs.question: Which is better, gypsum or POP false ceiling?
faqs.answer: Gypsum is better for most homes: it is faster, cleaner and gives a consistently flat finish. POP is better for curves, domes and detailed mouldings.

faqs.question: Which false ceiling is best for a bathroom?
faqs.answer: PVC panels, or a grid ceiling with moisture-resistant tiles, because gypsum and POP are damaged by moisture.

faqs.question: How much does a false ceiling cost per sq ft in Bangalore?
faqs.answer: In 2026, a plain gypsum ceiling costs about ₹70 to ₹110 per sq ft installed, a layered gypsum design with cove lighting ₹110 to ₹170, POP ₹65 to ₹110 and PVC ₹60 to ₹130 per sq ft.

faqs.question: Does a false ceiling reduce room height?
faqs.answer: Yes, usually by about 4 to 8 inches. Plan the drop with your ceiling height, especially in rooms below 10 ft.

faqs.question: Do gypsum false ceilings crack?
faqs.answer: Rarely, when the joints are taped and filled properly and the metal frame is spaced correctly. Cracks usually come from poor framing, joint finishing or leaks above.
